ACT IV OF 1973
ACT IV OF 1973
WEST PAKISTAN LAND
REVENUE (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
An Act to amend
the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967, in its application to the Barani and
Sailabi lands in the Province of Sind
[Gazette of Sind,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 29th June 1973]
(First published after having
received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the Gazette of Sind
Extraordinary), dated 28th June 1973).
No. PAS/Legis-B-4/73.---The
West Pakistan Land Revenue (Sind Amendment) Bill, 1973 having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of Sind on the 5th June 1973, and assented to by the
Governor of Sind on the 27th June 1973, is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sind :-
1. Short title.-This Act
may be called the West Pakistan Land Revenue (Sind Amendment) Act, 1973.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Land Revenue Sindh Amendment Act 1973
sections.description:
Revival of certain Provisions of West Pakistan Act XVII of 1967

ACT IV OF 1973
ACT IV OF 1973
WEST PAKISTAN LAND
REVENUE (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
An Act to amend
the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967, in its application to the Barani and
Sailabi lands in the Province of Sind
[Gazette of Sind,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 29th June 1973]
(First published after having
received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the Gazette of Sind
Extraordinary), dated 28th June 1973).
No. PAS/Legis-B-4/73.---The
West Pakistan Land Revenue (Sind Amendment) Bill, 1973 having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of Sind on the 5th June 1973, and assented to by the
Governor of Sind on the 27th June 1973, is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sind :-
2. Revival of certain
Provisions of West Pakistan Act XVII of 1967 --The amendments made and
repeals effected in the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967 (West Pakistan
Act, XVII of 1967) by the West Pakistan Land Revenue (Sind Amendment) Act, 1972
(Sind Act IX of 1972), shall, in relation to Barani and Sailabi lands, be
deemed to have never ,been made or effected.
Explanation.-For
the purpose of this Ordinance-
(i) "Barani
land" shall mean the land cultivation whereon is dependent on rainfall,
and
(ii)
"Sailabi land" shall mean the land cultivation whereon is dependent
on its having been flooded and kept moist by a river.
